plain: A cause of ruin or harm; something that spoils things.

webster.text: Poison of a deadly quality; hence, any fatal cause of mischief, injury or destruction; as, vice is the bane of society.

example.quote: Some of them think that the equality in the Senate is not a defect; others, that it is the bane of all good government.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 24, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
